deterministic_terraform_hcl_import_and_e.justification: Canonical import/export remains sorted and deterministic. A new schema reference order test proves schema-to-schema database references are resolved against the full resource graph rather than declaration order.

namespace_table_column_key_and_relations.justification: Supported namespaces, tables, columns, keys, relationships, comments and defaults round-trip through the canonical physical model and editable diagram path. The repaired default classifier preserves Snowflake expression defaults such as CURRENT_DATE and NULL while keeping call-shaped literals as constants.

explicit_rejection_of_unsupported_or_amb.justification: Unsupported resources, unsupported expressions, interpolation, template directives, non-string HCL literals in string-only attributes, unsupported nested default and foreign-key property block content, Terraform cloud/backend/state configuration, provider configuration, and ambiguous table namespace references are rejected with explicit errors.

preservation_of_existing_drawdb_and_snow.justification: Terraform import/export remains additive. Existing SQL import/export regression checks pass, and the full npm suite passed. Terraform import now applies the Snowflake database value so the export entry is reachable after import.

prohibitions_on_credentials_terraform_st.justification: No Terraform CLI invocation is present or tested as reachable; no terraform apply is run. Provider credentials, backend/cloud state configuration, tfstate-shaped JSON, and .tfvars upload affordance are rejected or avoided. No Python runtime dependency was added.

test_quality_and_coverage.justification: The Terraform suite now includes targeted regressions for the prior default-classification failure, Terraform template escaping, schema order independence, explicit database/schema mismatch rejection, non-string attribute literals, unsupported nested FK/default blocks, cloud state configuration rejection, and UI database switching.

review_environment_and_evidence_scope.justification: Review evidence includes focused Terraform tests, full npm test suite, lint, web production build, and desktop production build on the repaired tree.
